records.localized_text: Each supplementary panel shown indicates a reserved lane.

records.localized_text: Each supplementary panel shown, placed below a NO VEHICLES sign, indicates the recommended lane.

records.localized_text: The supplementary panel shown indicates a traffic slowdown caused by an accident.

records.localized_text: The supplementary panel shown recommends choosing an alternative route where possible.

records.localized_text: The supplementary panel shown indicates a road accident and the need to reduce speed.

records.localized_text: The supplementary panel shown indicates a highly dangerous road.

records.localized_text: The supplementary panel shown indicates the danger of collision with vehicles coming from the right.

records.localized_text: The supplementary panel shown gives advance warning of a stretch of road with a high probability of causing accidents.

source.text_it: Il pannello integrativo raffigurato può indicare che, in caso di violenti acquazzoni, la strada si può allagare

records.localized_text: The supplementary panel shown may indicate that the road can flood during heavy downpours.

source.text_it: Il pannello integrativo raffigurato può indicare il pericolo di allagamento della strada per mareggiate

records.localized_text: The supplementary panel shown may indicate the danger of the road flooding due to stormy seas.

records.localized_text: The supplementary panel shown may indicate a seaside resort.

source.text_it: Il pannello integrativo raffigurato può indicare, nelle località di montagna, la presenza di laghi naturali

records.localized_text: The supplementary panel shown may indicate natural lakes in mountain areas.

source.text_it: Il pannello integrativo raffigurato può indicare un tratto di strada con neve

records.localized_text: The supplementary panel shown may indicate a snow-covered road section.

source.text_it: Il pannello integrativo raffigurato invita, in caso di pioggia, ad aumentare la distanza di sicurezza

records.localized_text: The supplementary panel shown invites, in case of rain, to increase the safety distance

source.text_it: Il pannello integrativo raffigurato segnala un tratto di strada scivoloso in caso di pioggia

records.localized_text: The supplementary panel shown indicates a road section that is slippery when it rains.

records.localized_text: The supplementary panel shown indicates a road section where it often rains heavily.

records.localized_text: The supplementary panel shown indicates a road section made dangerous by crosswinds.

26104: The explanation identifies the cloud and drops but otherwise restates the question that the road becomes slippery in rain; add the causal distinction explaining why rain makes the surface slippery.
